title: Interpretation 13-14 (Redmond Fire Department): sprinkler exception for clusters of portable school classrooms (IBC/IFC 903.2.3)
jurisdiction: Washington State, requested by Redmond Fire Department (comparative test only; not Alberta)
code_edition: 2012 International Fire Code / International Building Code, Section 903.2.3 Exceptions 1 and 2, as cited

facts.text: Document type: State Building Code Council interpretation no. 13-14, three pages; requester Redmond Fire Department.

Exception 1 (as quoted): portable school classrooms with occupant load of 50 or less, where the aggregate area of clusters of portable school classrooms does not exceed 5,000 square feet and clusters are separated as the building code requires.
Question 1 asks whether portables not separated by the minimum IBC separation are aggregated for the 5,000 sf test; Question 3 asks whether the space between portables counts in the area.
Question 4 asks whether portables that do have the required separation are included in the aggregate.
Question 5 asks whether portables with an occupant load over 50 must be sprinklered, and Question 6 whether Exception 2 applies to portable buildings.
Question 7 asks whether occupant loads of classrooms connected within one portable building are aggregated.

limitations: The PDF contains the Council answer on the same page; do not present it as applicant-side input without flagging leakage.
